page.overview:
Who is Mindy Nguyen?

Mindy Nguyen is a character created by Canadian author Troy Young for his Nyarlathotep Cycle series of Cthulhu Mythos stories.

A tall, good-looking Asian woman with long black hair which she usually wears tied back, Mindy is trained in the combat techniques of Krav Maga.

Formerly an investigative reporter, Harjit Singh recruited Mindy into the Department of Extraordinary Phenomena around 2018 after her fiancé was tortured and killed by 'winged shrimp with legs' (most likely Mi-Go) whilst on a hiking trip.

A little over a year later, one of her assignments caused her to cross paths with an alien life form and its collection of exotic flora. This encounter left her with a heightened ability to sense the presence of otherworldly entities and influence.
